scope: development admission on five pre-registered ids; not unseen and not generalization
id_rule: first five ids of the published v7d development list, in that list's order; not chosen from FastV successes
prompt: week1_mechanism/run_eval.py build_prompt template A, executed from that file

loss.CE_surrogate: teacher-forced cross entropy of the bottleneck path on the real clean Full token ids, including a generated EOS and no extra EOS
loss.L_NativeFDP: mean softplus(clean_hard_margin - attack_hard_margin) on the real Full native forward; the clean hard margin is the floor, and no extra EOS is appended
loss.L_pixel_reg: mean(delta^2) + mean(abs horizontal difference) + mean(abs vertical difference)
loss.lambda_rule: lambda_fdp = ||grad CE|| / ||grad FDP|| and lambda_reg = ||grad CE|| / ||grad reg|| at +1/255 on sample 1025; written once and not changed after FastV

checkpoint_rule: Full native generate text and token ids equal the clean Full generate
every real clean token hard margin on that generate is positive
uint8 perturbation is nonzero and Linf <= 8/255 + 1e-6
among those, the smallest recorded surrogate objective, then the later step
checkpoint_forbidden: FastV text, ANLS, keep-set, or any target result
